page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: service category list (#serviceByCategoryList)
wcag_reference: ARIA role compatibility; WCAG mapping requires verification
evidence: DOM inspection confirms #serviceByCategoryList is a UL with explicit role="listitem" and contains 10 children. The list container is assigned the list-item role, which is intended for individual list items rather than the list itself.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may receive incorrect list semantics, potentially making the service categories harder to understand.
recommended_fix: Remove the incompatible role from the UL and preserve native list semantics, unless a different role is justified by the intended design. Verify the resulting accessibility tree.
status: Incompatible role confirmed by DOM inspection; WCAG mapping and remediation require verification

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: footer links and informational text
evidence: Lighthouse reported 'Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio' for specific footer elements, including Calendar, India Portal 2.0 Brochure, and informational paragraphs. Sampled footer text measured 19.08:1 for headings, 17.68:1 for links, and 13.51:1 for secondary text against rgb(9, 9, 9). The sampled elements passed the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold; the exact cause of Lighthouse's warning remains unverified.
user_impact: Users with low vision may have difficulty reading text if any flagged elements have insufficient contrast.
recommended_fix: Verify the actual rendered foreground and background colors for each Lighthouse-flagged element, including relevant themes and backgrounds. Confirm the contrast ratios before identifying a WCAG failure.
status: Lighthouse contrast warning observed; sampled footer text passed contrast checks; exact cause not yet verified

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: initiatives carousel
wcag_reference: WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order - candidate; mapping requires verification
evidence: Console inspection found four links with tabIndex 0 inside elements marked aria-hidden=true: Register / Login to E-Sampada Website of Directorate of Estates of Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs; Register Your Tourism Unit; Check list of villages and towns by sub-district level; Search for Basic Heritage hotels approved by Ministry of Tourism.
user_impact: Keyboard users may reach links hidden from assistive technology, potentially causing confusing focus and reading order.
recommended_fix: Ensure inactive carousel slides do not contain keyboard-focusable links. Keep slide visibility, accessibility-tree exposure and keyboard focus behavior consistent, then test carousel navigation.
status: Console confirms focusable links inside aria-hidden elements; manual keyboard behavior and final WCAG mapping require verification

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: footer links and expandable button
evidence: Lighthouse flagged multiple footer elements for target size or spacing. DOM measurements found Category at 69.54 × 22 CSS px, Directory at 70.63 × 22 CSS px, and About Us at 57.08 × 18 CSS px. The Category button measured 109.17 × 32 CSS px. Spacing between neighboring clickable targets has not yet been verified.
user_impact: Small interactive targets may be harder for users with limited dexterity to activate accurately.
recommended_fix: Verify target dimensions and spacing between neighboring interactive elements against WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8, including applicable exceptions. Increase target size or spacing where necessary.
status: Lighthouse warning observed and target dimensions measured; neighboring target spacing and WCAG compliance require further verification

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: linked carousel images
wcag_reference: Potential redundant alternative text; WCAG mapping requires verification
evidence: DOM inspection found eight linked images whose alt text exactly matches their link text. Inspection of the first four found that each link contains one image, no separate text nodes, and no additional images. Matching text alone does not establish duplicate screen-reader announcements; the computed accessible names and screen-reader output have not been verified.
user_impact: If accessible names are announced redundantly, screen-reader users may hear repeated information when navigating these links.
recommended_fix: Inspect the computed accessible name and test representative links with a screen reader. Keep meaningful alt text where it provides the link name; use empty alt text only when the image is decorative and its information is conveyed elsewhere.
status: Eight matching image/link text pairs observed; actual announcement behavior and WCAG mapping require verification
